prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function leftCycle(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse canonical k;values where k is an unsigned decimal in 0..1000000 and values is a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed integers in -1000..1000. Rotate the list left by k modulo its length and return comma-separated values. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 7;10,20,30 returns 20,30,10.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=(s:string):number[]|null=>{if(!s)return null;let o:number[]=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};export function leftCycle(s:string):string|null{let p=s.split(';');if(p.length!==2||!/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(p[0])||Number(p[0])>1000000)return null;let a=nums(p[1]);if(!a)return null;let k=Number(p[0]),n=k%a.length;return a.slice(n).concat(a.slice(0,n)).join(',')}
